# template-paths-allowlist.txt -- existing offenders of the `templates` class
# test in docs/SPEC-CI.md. One row: file:line kind date reason.

# The file only shrinks. An entry that names no offender on the tree is refused
# (`quote the path; the allowlist only shrinks`), so fixing a path means
# deleting its row in the same change, and a new row parks nothing.
#
# These two predate the checker: filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(...)) into a
# JSON worker description kept the Windows reds (#904, #920) from firing, but
# the allowed shape is strconv.Quote.
